cim: An artificial intelligence with a neighborhood vocation
cim_eredeti: An artificial intelligence with a neighborhood vocation
szoveg_eredeti:
Artificial intelligence has infiltrated all economic and social sectors, even making a place for itself in the daily lives of citizens. However, this technology, on many occasions, is at the service of large companies. Rarely, due to limited resources and size, can local shops and stores implement innovative solutions that would make them stand out. Especially in terms of visibility, they always end up falling into oblivion in the face of the giants of the sector who, with little, achieve much more. That is why the Cambra de Comerç de Barcelona —thanks to the development of the Barcelona start-up ELEVA AI— has launched LaIA C, an assistant to converse via WhatsApp in different languages that will allow any visitor to discover news about shops, restaurants, and offers in real time.

"Local commerce is what gives life to our towns and cities, and artificial intelligence cannot be a privilege of large operators," said Agustí Filomeno, director of Commerce, Tourism and Culture of the Cambra, in a statement. The reality, then, is that there are increasingly more differences in technology implementation and it seems that local shops and stores cannot always keep up. With this tool, the visibility of their products is practically immediate for visitors, which puts them back at the center of the Catalan capital, a space they have been losing to large companies. According to the Cambra, LaIA C is not "a generic chatbot" but an assistant with a dual function. First, it seeks to offer shops and establishments an updated digital channel to promote themselves and reach new customers, and second, to help local consumers and visitors discover shops, products, services, and offers in real time.

The solution was born to boost the digital revolution among local businesses, which employ hundreds of thousands of people in Catalonia and shape the living soul of each neighborhood. As the Cambra's statement explained as context, "for two decades, online commerce has captured a large part of technological investment and data intelligence, but small retailers have been largely excluded from this revolution, without tools or data to know their visitors or to compete on equal terms with the large operators in the sector." With the arrival of LaIA C, the aim is to restore a certain priority to these local businesses.

Xavi Pin (ELEVA AI): "LaIA C allows for the first time that an axis can know, in real time, what people are looking for"

This is an innovative tool and is still in its first phase. In this way, it will become operational before Black Friday for businesses on Diagonal between Passeig de Gràcia and Plaça Francesc Macià, Rambla de Catalunya and the center of Mataró, with the collaboration of the associations Diagonal Boulevard, Rambla de Catalunya and NEM– Negoci Empresa Mataró. To facilitate interaction with the public, it can be accessed through a QR code that directly opens the conversation via WhatsApp. "LaIA C allows for the first time that an axis can know, in real time, what people passing through are looking for and give them a useful answer at the moment," specified Xavi Pin, CEO and co-founder of ELEVA AI.

For businesses on the participating streets, LaIA C represents a 24-hour visibility channel. Thus, the assistant recommends it when a visitor makes a query related to what it sells, and gives the shopkeeper a space to publish their weekly promotions. There is nothing more tedious for a local or a tourist than going round and round the same websites where the information is not updated. That is why this tool works with live information, which is constantly transforming. In addition, to make it to everyone's taste, answers can also be found in several languages. In this way, international tourists, "usually neglected by local circuits," will also be able to use it, the Cambra explained in the statement.

The initiative kicks off before Black Friday, but it will be extended. In this regard, for Christmas, LaIA C will deploy a specific campaign Shops? Fashion? Beauty? Decoration? Restaurants? to position the assistant as a gift guide for local commerce, suggest ideas and help citizens find what they need, in the highest billing season of the year. "The commercial axes of towns and cities deserved to have the same intelligence as large centers," Pin recalled.

This tool works with live information, which is constantly transforming

Although the tool is in its early stages, the technology it uses has already been tested and is a complete success. Specifically, it is the same system that ELEVA AI has deployed in the shopping centers Westfield La Maquinista, La Gavia (Klépierre) and Parque Abadía (Redevco), and from November 20 also at Keflavík Airport (Iceland). According to ELEVA AI, in these spaces, the technology has accumulated more than 75,000 real conversations, and has shown that 7 out of 10 people who interact with the assistant express an intention to buy. Thus, it seems that the initiative has all the ingredients to catapult local businesses to success.
